name: TimeWarp.Architecture Template Host
description: Agent-ready .NET template host by TimeWarp Enterprises. Live: passkey and agent-key identity REST APIs, OpenAPI, discovery docs, and Agent Skills. Full A2A JSON-RPC task protocol is not hosted yet — this is an unsigned v1 discoverability card (signed cards later). Prefer REST identity ceremonies (/auth.md), OpenAPI (/openapi/v1.json), and /.well-known/agent-skills/ for operational use.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Short-lived scoped opaque bearer from POST /api/identity/agent/token after ECDSA P-256 proof-of-possession. See /auth.md and the timewarp-identity skill.

skills.name: Register agent public key
skills.description: Register an ECDSA P-256 agent public key without a human sponsor via POST /api/identity/agent/register/options then /register.
examples: Register my agent key and receive principalId and keyId

skills.name: Issue scoped agent bearer token
skills.description: Complete the agent token ceremony (options + signed proof) to receive a short-lived opaque scoped bearer token.
examples: Issue a bearer token with scope identity:read

skills.name: Who am I (agent session)
skills.description: Call GET /api/identity/agent/me with Authorization: Bearer to inspect the authenticated principal.
examples: Who am I with this bearer token?

skills.name: Read agent discovery surfaces
skills.description: Fetch llms.txt, auth.md, OpenAPI, MCP/A2A cards, and the Agent Skills index for this host.
examples: What agent protocols and APIs does this host advertise?
